title: Coordinate noise distribution
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with at least two elements, and let $\rho$ satisfy $-1/(|\Omega|-1)\le\rho\le1$. For each $x\in\Omega$, define a probability distribution on $\Omega$ that assigns mass $\bigl(1+(|\Omega|-1)\rho\bigr)/|\Omega|$ to $x$ and mass $(1-\rho)/|\Omega|$ to each other element.
